description: List the agent's UI skills - the rich WhatsApp components (carousels, CTA URLs, flows, images, interactive lists and buttons, location) the agent may send, each with the instruction that says when to send it. A UI skill is NOT an agent skill (mba_list_agent_skills): an agent skill is instruction text that shapes what the agent says, a UI skill lets the agent send one kind of rich WhatsApp component and tells it when to send that component. This list is CURSOR-PAGINATED: it returns {data, paging} - page with the `after` cursor from paging.cursors, and stop when paging carries no `next` link, because a page can be empty and still have more after it.

after.description: Cursor - return the page immediately after it.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

before.description: Cursor - return the page immediately before it.

limit.description: Maximum entries per page. A page can be shorter.

name: mba_list_ui_skills
title: List UI skills
